# Logistics 0.2.0

Logistics 0.2.0

Mobile Documents and Notes Library updates include filename search by default, separate Files/Search results, Recent links to library sections, and Android Back handling for search and drawers. Marked libraries in Local and unlocked LocalCrypt should appear automatically in Documents, including Session-Only libraries. Please test nested notes, navigation and credential locking. Pulling a file already open as a document should complete while preserving an unsaved draft; a stale save must not overwrite the pulled content.

Notebook changes include drawing and selection controls, single-use stroke paste, zoom controls that appear temporarily after zooming, draft/Save As recovery, and Quit Without Saving. Shared Files, Local and Received Files retain their dedicated save routes. Main mobile destinations no longer repeat their names above their content. Where measured corner-status space fits every target, reader controls use the free area beside it while the page stays clear. EPUB Close and browse stay adjacent. Notebook drawing tools move closer to portrait controls and share the title row in supported wide landscape layouts. Accent text and controls retain the chosen hue and saturation in both themes; Android sliders preview changes while dragging and apply across the app on release. Classic iOS Picture in Picture is the default; the subtitle compositor is optional. iOS captures Pencil contacts in the native window before normal event forwarding. View and input includes Constant stylus pressure for this open document.

Protected PDF notebooks avoid repeated password checks and classify off the UI thread. Encrypted PDFs unlock faster on Android. iOS Read aloud retries failed initial voice discovery automatically.

Desktop video recovery avoids a redundant seek that could leave the displayed frame frozen after buffering. Build tooling now repairs missing pinned SDK and commonUtils commits in verified managed source caches before VM testing.

Notes Library Data Views: users may author or import Markdown notes containing complete, top-level dataviewjs blocks and JavaScript view files in their own selected library. These user-supplied scripts execute automatically when the containing note is opened in Notes Library reading mode on desktop or mobile; there is currently no separate library-trust prompt. Opening a JavaScript source file in the editor does not execute it. JSON files are data: a user-authored script may read and parse them to produce tables, lists, links and other supported document views. JSON itself is not executable code.

This is an independent, limited Data View compatibility layer, not an Obsidian plugin host. Scripts run in a disposable browser worker with a 30-second execution limit. Supported native requests provide bounded reads and Markdown metadata inside the selected library; paths outside that library and hidden configuration are rejected. Scripts do not receive the native application API or the document DOM. The worker document's content security policy restricts network access. Rendered output is escaped or constructed through supported display helpers; script and output limits apply. Source blocks remain editable in the user's note, while generated results are display content. Users should inspect code in notes and view files they import before opening those notes in reading mode.

Please test rapid Pencil dots and handwriting, reader controls and usable page space in portrait, landscape and folded layouts, drawing/save/reopen, local and encrypted documents, library search, playback, transfer cancellation and rotation with the keyboard open. Physical Pencil reliability remains under investigation; passing synthetic input checks does not establish hardware reliability.

Transfer screens rebuild an unresponsive web view once, then use native progress and review controls if needed. Display recovery does not restart a transfer or bypass confirmation. Intermittent native crashes and WebKit page-loading stalls have been observed in automated iOS simulator testing; investigation continues. Report navigation, loading, rotation or missing-input failures with the device, OS, build number and reproduction steps.
